_note: Draft English of Saadia's JA Tafsir on Bereshit 19 (Sodom destruction; Lot and daughters). Saadia-specific moves: v.18 'יא רסול אללה' = 'O messenger of God' (substitute for 'אדני'); v.22 צוער=זג'ר/Zagar (Saadia gives the Arabic toponym); v.26 'נצבת מלח' = 'a pillar of salt' (literal); v.29 'אלמקלב' = 'the overthrow' (Saadia's gloss for ההפכה).

translations.1: Then the two angels came to Sodom at the time of evening; and Lot was sitting at its gate. And when he saw them, he rose to meet them, and bowed down upon his face to the earth.
translations.2: He said: 'O my two lords! Turn aside to the house of your servant, and lodge, and wash your feet; and you shall rise early, and go on your way.' They said: 'No; rather, we shall lodge in the open square.'
translations.3: But he urged them strongly; so they turned aside to him, and entered his house; and he made them a feast, and baked them unleavened bread, and they ate.
translations.4: Before they lay down — and behold, the men of the city, the men of Sodom, had surrounded the house, from small to great — all the people who were in its quarter.
translations.5: And they called to Lot, and said to him: 'Where are the men who entered to you this night? Bring them out to us, that we may know them.'
translations.6: And Lot went out to them, to the door, and shut the bolt behind him.
translations.7: He said: 'O my brothers, do not do evil to them.
translations.8: Behold, I have two daughters who have not known a man; let me bring them out to you, and do to them what is good in your eyes; only to these men, do nothing — for they have entered under the shade of my roof.'
translations.9: And they said: 'Come hither!' Then they said: 'Has one come to dwell with us — and now he sets himself to judge over us? Now we shall do worse to you than to them.' And they pressed greatly upon Lot, and drew near to break the bolt.
translations.10: Then the men put forth their hands, and brought Lot in to them, into the house; and they shut the bolt.
translations.11: And the men who were at the door of the house, they struck with blindness, from young to old; and they grew weary of finding the door.
translations.12: The men said to Lot: 'Who do you have here — son-in-law, your sons, your daughters, and all whom you have in the city — bring them out from this place.
translations.13: For we are destroying this place — for their cry has grown great before God; so He has sent us to destroy them.'
translations.14: And Lot went out, and spoke to his sons-in-law who had married his daughters; and he said: 'Arise, go out from this place — for God is destroying it.' And he was in their sight as one jesting.
translations.15: And as the dawn was rising, the angels urged Lot, saying: 'Arise, take your wife and your two daughters who are present, lest you be swept away in the iniquity of the dwellers of the land.'
translations.16: But he tarried; and the men seized his hand and the hand of his wife and the hands of his two daughters — through God's compassion upon him — and they brought him out, and left him outside the city.
translations.17: And when they had brought him outside, they said to him: 'Escape with your life! Do not look behind you, nor stand anywhere in the plain. Flee to the mountain, lest you be swept away.'
translations.18: And Lot said to them: 'No, O messenger of God!
translations.19: Behold, your servant has found favor with you; and you have made great your kindness, which you have done with me, to keep my soul alive. But I cannot escape to the mountain, lest the calamity overtake me, and I perish.
translations.20: Behold, this town is near, that I may flee to it; and it is small. Let me escape to it — though it is small — and my soul shall live.'
translations.21: He said to him: 'Behold, I have accepted your intercession in this matter as well — not to overturn the town concerning which you have asked.
translations.22: Hasten, escape to it — for I cannot do anything until you enter it.' Therefore the town was called Zoar.
translations.23: The sun rose over the earth; and Lot entered Zoar.
translations.24: And God rained upon Sodom and Gomorrah brimstone and fire from Him, from the sky.
translations.25: And He overturned those towns, and all the plain, and all their inhabitants — even their vegetation.
translations.26: And his wife looked from behind him; and she became a pillar of salt.
translations.27: And Abraham rose early in the morning to the place where he had stood before God.
translations.28: And he looked out over the face of Sodom and Gomorrah, and the rest of the land of the plain; and he looked — and behold, its smoke had gone up like the smoke of a furnace.
translations.29: And when God destroyed the towns of the plain, God remembered Abraham, and rescued Lot out of the midst of the overthrow — when He overturned the towns in which Lot had dwelt.
translations.30: And Lot went up from Zoar, and settled in the mountain; and his two daughters were with him — for he was afraid to dwell in Zoar. And he dwelt in the cave, he and his two daughters.
translations.31: And the elder said to the younger: 'Our father is old; and there is no man in the land to come to us in the way of all the earth.
translations.32: Come, let us make our father drink wine, and lie with him, and let us preserve from our father offspring.'
translations.33: And they made their father drink wine that night; and the elder rose and lay with him; and he did not know of her lying down or her rising.
translations.34: And on the morrow, the elder said to the younger: 'Behold, I lay last night with my father. Let us make him drink wine tonight as well; and you go in, lie with him, that we may preserve from our father offspring.'
translations.35: And they made their father drink wine that night also; and the younger rose, and lay with him; and he did not know of her lying down or her rising.
translations.36: And the two daughters of Lot conceived from their father.
translations.37: And the elder bore a son, and named him Moab; he is the father of the Moabites to this day.
translations.38: And the younger — she too bore a son, and named him Ben-Ammi; he is the father of the children of Ammon to this day.
